critique.evidence: Measured loading is demo-ready across viewports: LCP is 1288 ms desktop, 1156 ms tablet, and 308 ms mobile; FCP is 52–72 ms; TTFB is 1.5–7.5 ms. Layout stability is strong (CLS 0 desktop/mobile and 0.0478 tablet), with document width matching every viewport. No console, page, or request failures occurred. Tablet/mobile frame samples hold near 16.67 ms with no long frames; desktop is weaker at 19.31 ms average and 33.4 ms worst. The main performance liability is 1.314 MB transferred, dominated by 1.149 MB of JavaScript, on all three viewports.
critique.fix: Reduce the 1.15 MB JavaScript payload through route-level code splitting, tree-shaking, and deferred loading of non-Atlas screens/data. Profile desktop rendering to bring average frame time under 16.7 ms, and eliminate the modest tablet layout shift.
